headlines.title: Strategy Is Down 45% From Its High. Saylor Sees “the Next Bitcoin Bull Market”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysStrategy is down 45% from its high a year ago after bitcoin fell below what it paid for its coins and its STRC preferred stock slipped under $100, a slide that also hit MARA Holdings and Coinbase. Executive Chairman Michael Saylor says the next bitcoin bull market has begun, but Strategy’s bitcoin per share is down 3.

headlines.title: Strategy Gains 7% as Bitcoin Rallies After Midterms, CEO Touts “Bitcoin Capital Cycle”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysStrategy shares rose 7% today as Bitcoin and the broader market rallied after the midterm elections. CEO Phong Le ranked Strategy fourth among US stock sellers in 2026, calling it a “Bitcoin capital cycle.

headlines.title: Michael Saylor Keeps Buying Bitcoin While ETF Investors Sell. Strategy Added 811 Coins While BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF Saw $405.3 Million Pulled Out In A Single Day
headlines.summary: Michael Saylor keeps stacking bitcoin even as ETF investors flee in one of the biggest single-day outflows of the year, but the numbers reveal something unexpected about where Strategy Inc. is actually spending most of its cash.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
